scope_outcomes.criterion: A supplied citing-author text that makes an anchored argument about Max Weber, recorded as a reference reading rather than as an independent secondary-reception reader
scope_outcomes.basis: The text explicitly identifies Weber as a canonical sociologist and argues that canonical status results from translations, edited volumes, and curricula; it also criticizes approaches that replace analysis of ideas with annotated bibliographies.
limitations: This is a reference reading by the citing author, not an independent secondary reader in the reception sample.
The text does not provide a substantive interpretation of Weber’s sociological concepts.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
